resources.string: Private, on-device intelligence built into your phone.

Enable network location to determine your location more accurately and efficiently, including indoors. Nearby wireless signal identifiers are sent through the configured privacy proxy only while network location is in use.

Enable the geocoder so apps can use the configured privacy-preserving network service to convert between geographic coordinates and human-readable addresses. Some apps need this for critical functionality.
If you have a backup from your previous AIOS device, you can restore it here.
